question_text: A 67-year-old man is seen on the surgical floor after a transplant procedure. The previous day, the patient had a renal transplant from a matched donor. The patient's current medications include lisinopril, atorvastain, insulin, and aspirin. Prior to the procedure, he was also on dialysis. The patient is started on cyclosporine. The patient successfully recovers over the next few days. Which of the following medications should be started in this patient?
